sample_fixes.grounded_explanation: Added aria-label="Search components" to the input element to provide an accessible name for screen readers, addressing the missing label violation per WCAG 3.3.2.
sample_fixes.grounded_diff:
--- a/src/components/Header.tsx
+++ b/src/components/Header.tsx
@@ -1 +1 @@
-      <input id="search-box" type="search" placeholder="Search components..." />

+      <input id="search-box" type="search" placeholder="Search components..." aria-label="Search components" />
sample_fixes.ungrounded_explanation: Added aria-label="Search components" to the input element to provide an accessible name for screen readers, satisfying WCAG 3.3.2. The placeholder attribute does not serve as a label.
sample_fixes.ungrounded_diff:
--- a/src/components/Header.tsx
+++ b/src/components/Header.tsx
@@ -1 +1 @@
-      <input id="search-box" type="search" placeholder="Search components..." />

+      <input id="search-box" type="search" placeholder="Search components..." aria-label="Search components" />

sample_fixes.grounded_explanation: Added a <label> with htmlFor referencing the textarea's new id="feedback-id" to provide an accessible name per WCAG 3.3.2. The label text 'User Feedback' describes the field's purpose. The placeholder remains but is no longer the sole accessible name source.
sample_fixes.grounded_diff:
--- a/src/components/LoginForm.tsx
+++ b/src/components/LoginForm.tsx
@@ -1,4 +1,6 @@
+        <label htmlFor="feedback-id">User Feedback</label>

         <textarea

+          id="feedback-id"

           placeholder="Provide user feedback..."

           value={feedback}

           onChange={(e) => setFeedback(e.target.value)}
